name: Customer
documentation: An individual or organisation that initiates payment requests through the checkout process. The Customer is the primary external actor who triggers the Customer Checkout Process in the legacy payment system.

name: Customer Service Representative
documentation: A business role responsible for handling escalations and manual overrides within the payment processing workflow. This role intervenes when automated processes fail or when human judgment and manual reconciliation are required.

name: Customer Checkout Process
documentation: The end-to-end business process that orchestrates the full payment flow, starting from the moment the Customer initiates a payment through to final settlement. It coordinates interactions between the Customer, the Payment Gateway Service, and the underlying Payment Processing Service. The process reads and writes the Payment Request business object.

name: Payment Gateway Service
documentation: A business service that exposes payment execution capability — including card verification and settlement — to the business layer. It is realized by the Payment Gateway Application Component in the application layer. This service acts as the externally facing capability for processing payment transactions.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/docs/architecture.md, Section: Business Layer, line 11; Section: Relationships, line 31

name: Payment Request
documentation: A business data entity representing a payment initiation request. It carries all relevant data about a payment transaction as initiated by the Customer through the Customer Checkout Process, such as payment amount, destination account, and payment instrument details.
